intro: Technology, manufacturing, research, software development, and government sectors faced a wave of remote code execution attacks between April 12 and May 19, 2026, with 31 articles covering the tag. The threat actor PhantomCore was observed, alongside critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, CVE-2026-45033, and CVE-2026-4883, each carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. The severity mix comprised 19 critical, 11 high, and 1 medium incidents, with significant impacts reported across Asia, China, and Russia.
